{%- comment -%} Shadow of just-the-docs's vendor jekyll-anchor-headings include. The 170-line Liquid loop is replaced by the `jtd_anchor_headings` Liquid filter, registered in `_plugins/anchor-headings-fast.rb`. Scope matches the upstream: `include.html` is the page-content string the upstream template would have processed, so headings inserted into the layout AFTER this include (notably the auto-TOC h2 from `toc_heading_custom.html`, added by `children_nav.html`) are left untouched -- same as upstream. The filter produces compress.html-collapsed output directly: a single space inside the opening tag, around any injected anchor, and before the closing tag. Compress.html sees no internal whitespace to collapse, so the final HTML is byte-identical with what the upstream Liquid template + compress.html produced. {%- endcomment -%} {{ include.html | jtd_anchor_headings }}
